card.name: Positions before a hyphen or citation year
card.fires_on: Marks where a hyphen, slash or number is expected next: a citation year after "et al.", "/kg" after a dose unit, or a modifier before a hyphenated term. It appears mostly in chemical or environmental science text and in infusion instructions.

modes.label: Citation years
modes.description: The space or first digit of a year after an author citation such as "et al.".

modes.label: Per-kg units
modes.description: The "/kg" part of a unit right after a mass amount.
modes.example: administered to rats at a dose of 50 mg<</kg>>/day in combination with 12.

modes.label: Words before a hyphenated term
modes.description: A word or word part that leads into a hyphenated compound, such as "low-protein binding".

card.plain: It fires at points in scientific text where a hyphen, slash or year is about to come next, such as a citation year or a per-kg unit.
